text_block_list.text:
Our third summer training camp had begun. 
Aiming for a complete resurgence at the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup, 
I pushed her conditioning even further—
choice_data_list:
Remember, pushing too hard is strictly 
forbidden.

Remember, pushing too hard is strictly 
forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand. 
...Though, to be honest...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I completely forget 
about my injury.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking normally, running... 
competing. 
It feels impossible that this body isn't 
the same as before.

The surgery was a success. However, 
re-injuring 
a damaged area is always a possibility... 
especially having undergone an 
unprecedented procedure.

Just how much top-level strain 
she can endure... remains an unknown.

Once again, training decisions will 
require feeling out 
that razor-thin edge every single time. 
Even so—
choice_data_list: You haven't reached your ceiling yet.
You haven't reached your ceiling yet.

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact made a magnificent return to 
the front lines, 
and she continues to grow stronger even 
now... Seeing it 
up close, I knew that better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please make me stronger, Trainer. 
Even in this world where fresh winds rage—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Grant me the undeniable strength to bloom 
proudly. 
I'm counting on you!

And with that, our passionate summer 
training camp kicked off!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that reminds me. 
Trainer, there was something 
I wanted to ask you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if an octopus 
were sent to our training lodgings?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Erimo catches octopus year-round, 
but it seems they've caught some 
exceptionally 
large ones this year.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The neighbors mentioned wanting to send 
one 
to fuel our summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: An octopus... would that be difficult?

...And thus, our heated summer training 
camp began!
